Amumu.fight: After dodging Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy, approach with Rammus Q Powerball and catch him with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. Amumu has no skill to create distance on his own, so attack with your allies after catching him. Adjust your distance so you don’t stay near Amumu W Despair for long while it’s active.
Amumu.teamfight: Spread out and fight in open areas so Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy doesn’t stun several allies at once. Start the fight after Amumu uses R, and look for an angle to use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt on a main damage dealer in the back line.
Amumu.watch: If Amumu Q Bandage Toss hits you, he can follow up while you’re stunned, so dodge with a minion or jungle monster between you. Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy can stun nearby allies too, so spread out and fight in open areas while his R is ready. Amumu W Despair deals damage based on your maximum health while you’re nearby, so don’t stay close to him for long.
Amumu.escape: A missed Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy being down is an opening to engage. Approach with Rammus Q Powerball and use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt to catch Amumu, who has no skill to create distance on his own.
Amumu.build: Build magic resistance before stacking armor to prepare for Amumu’s magic damage. You can buy Spirit Visage or Banshee’s Veil earlier, and Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl also increases magic resistance. Consider tenacity or a way to remove crowd control to prepare for being caught and damaged by Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy.
Amumu.combo: Roll Rammus Q Powerball from out of sight ahead of time to build speed. Just before hitting Amumu, use Rammus R Soaring Slam while rolling to aim for the knock-up at the center of its area. After landing, use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. When Amumu starts attacking Rammus, activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl and land basic attacks.
Amumu.laning: Early on, Rammus clears camps slowly and deals little damage on his own, so don’t fixate on a farming contest. Once Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt are available, roll Q from out of sight ahead of time to look for a gank angle. Move with a minion or jungle monster between you and Amumu Q Bandage Toss so you can dodge it.

Kindred.combo: While rolling with Rammus Q Powerball, cast Rammus R Soaring Slam just before you reach the target to knock up enemies in the center. Follow with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt on Kindred. When Kindred starts attacking you, activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl. If Rammus Q Powerball collides and stops first, you can no longer get the knockup from Rammus R Soaring Slam.
Kindred.build: Build armor first to reduce the physical damage from Kindred Q Dance of Arrows and E Mounting Dread. Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy calls for magic resistance, and if a long fight makes healing a problem, build resistances first, then consider Grievous Wounds. Rammus P Spiked Shell also increases your attack damage when you build defensive stats.
Kindred.escape: Your chance to engage comes after Kindred uses both Q Dance of Arrows and W Wolf's Frenzy to escape. In particular, use Rammus R Soaring Slam to close in before Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy comes back up, then follow with Rammus Q Powerball and E Frenzying Taunt. If there’s no opening, use Rammus Q Powerball to retreat along a path where you won’t collide with an enemy or minion and stop.
Kindred.fight: Use Rammus R Soaring Slam to close the gap before Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy comes back up. If only one of Kindred Q Dance of Arrows and W Wolf's Frenzy is down, Kindred still has another way to move, so don’t rush in. Once you’re close, stop Kindred’s movement with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, and activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl when Kindred starts attacking.
Kindred.laning: Rammus clears camps slowly early, so spend your time on ganks and joining objective fights after you have Rammus Q Powerball and E Frenzying Taunt instead of competing for farm. Clear jungle camps marked by P Mark of the Kindred first, or secure vision around them to delay Kindred from claiming the mark. When ganking, start rolling Rammus Q Powerball from out of vision to build speed.
Kindred.phase: Rammus has a weak camp clear and low damage alone early, but Kindred is also vulnerable to pressure, so use vision and contest marked camps to slow Kindred’s growth. Rammus’s damage also increases as his defensive stats build up in the mid to late game. If you’ve delayed Kindred from claiming P Mark of the Kindred, that also limits the growth of Kindred’s damage and range.
Kindred.teamfight: Stand where Kindred can attack with basic attacks to apply pressure, and use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt to lock Kindred down when you can engage. When Kindred R Lamb's Respite is active, enter the area with low-health allies to benefit from the protection and healing at the end. You can also use Rammus Q Powerball to push Kindred or the target she’s trying to save out of the area.
Kindred.watch: If Kindred E Mounting Dread marks you, create distance or break vision so you don’t get hit repeatedly. Its damage is more dangerous when your health is low. Kindred can keep escaping with Kindred Q Dance of Arrows inside the area of Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy, so look for an angle to push Kindred out of the area with Rammus Q Powerball.

Nocturne.laning: Early on, Rammus clears camps slowly and deals little damage alone, so spend time on ganks and objective plays instead of competing for farm. Keep vision around the river and jungle entrances so you know where to retreat before Nocturne R Paranoia is cast. If you’re hit by Nocturne Q Duskbringer, don’t run straight along its trail; angle toward your allies or a turret.
Nocturne.build: Buy defensive items first and prioritize armor. Nocturne deals primarily physical damage, and Rammus P Spiked Shell also increases your attack damage when you build defensive stats. Remember that armor won’t block the magic damage from Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror.
Nocturne.combo: Start rolling Rammus Q Powerball out of vision to build speed, then approach Nocturne. If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is active, remove the spell shield with the collision from Rammus Q Powerball, then use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. When Nocturne starts attacking Rammus, activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl.
Nocturne.escape: You can also use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt when Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is down. If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror is connected, create distance first to break the fear tether.
Nocturne.fight: Look to engage once you have Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is active, remove the spell shield with Rammus Q Powerball, then use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. When Nocturne actually starts attacking Rammus, activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl.
Nocturne.phase: Early on, Rammus is weak at clearing camps and dealing damage alone, so look for ganks once you have Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. In the mid to late game, defensive items increase both your armor and damage, and in the late game you can also apply pressure by taking down turrets.
Nocturne.teamfight: When Nocturne R Paranoia darkens the map, group with your allies so no one is left alone. If Nocturne dives onto an ally, counter his engage in front of your allied carry with the knockback from Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt.
Nocturne.watch: Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness blocks one ability, and if it blocks one, his attack speed increases significantly. If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror is connected, create distance to break the tether before the fear triggers. When Nocturne R Paranoia darkens the screen, don’t retreat alone; move toward your allies immediately.

Belveth.phase: Bel’Veth is weakest early, before she has stacks, so steal her camps then to slow her growth. Rammus gets stronger in the mid to late game as he builds defensive stats, but Bel’Veth’s stacks last permanently, making her harder to deal with as the game goes on. If fights stall in the late game, Rammus can pressure turrets.
Belveth.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Bel’Veth Q Void Surge and Bel’Veth E Royal Maelstrom. You need magic resistance against the magic damage from Bel’Veth W Above and Below, and total health to withstand the true damage from Bel’Veth R Endless Banquet.
Belveth.combo: Roll Rammus Q Powerball from out of sight ahead of time to build speed, and approach while Bel’Veth Q Void Surge is down. To land a knock-up, use Rammus R Soaring Slam while rolling just before reaching Bel’Veth, then follow with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. When Bel’Veth starts attacking Rammus, activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl.
Belveth.escape: Sidestep Bel’Veth W Above and Below. When Bel’Veth Q Void Surge is down, that’s your opening to engage. Close the distance with Rammus R Soaring Slam, then catch her with Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt before Bel’Veth Q Void Surge comes back up.
Belveth.fight: Apply crowd control right after Bel’Veth Q Void Surge is down and fight before she can dash again. Save your attacks while Bel’Veth E Royal Maelstrom is active, and interrupt the cast with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt if you can.
Belveth.laning: Rammus clears camps slowly early on, so focus on ganks and objective fights once Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt are available instead of forcing a farming contest. Bel’Veth is weak early before she builds stacks, so steal camps and large monsters in favorable encounters to slow her growth.
Belveth.teamfight: If Bel’Veth is the main damage dealer, engage with Rammus Q Powerball, catch her with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, and place the aftershock from Rammus R Soaring Slam where Bel’Veth will have to pass through. If you don’t have an angle to taunt her, stand in front of your allies and use Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt to counter her engage. If an ally falls and Void Coral drops, retreat before Bel’Veth can pick it up, and delay the next teamfight while she is transformed.
Belveth.watch: Bel’Veth W Above and Below knocks you up and resets Bel’Veth Q Void Surge’s cooldown, so sidestep when she approaches. Bel’Veth E Royal Maelstrom reduces the damage she takes, so save your attacks and interrupt it with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt if you can, or wait for it to end.

Fiddlesticks.watch: Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm channels, then moves and deals area damage. If you see it being cast, interrupt it with Rammus Q Powerball or E Frenzying Taunt. If you can’t interrupt it, move out of range and let it run its course. In brush where you have no vision, Fiddlesticks’ abilities can fear you just by hitting you, so don’t pass by a Scarecrow Effigy or through a narrow entrance without checking first.
Fiddlesticks.build: Fiddlesticks deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first instead of stacking only armor. You can get Spirit Visage or Banshee’s Veil early. Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl also increases magic resistance, but prioritize walking out of Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm’s area.
Fiddlesticks.combo: Roll Rammus Q Powerball in advance from out of vision to build speed, then approach Fiddlesticks. To knock him up with Rammus R Soaring Slam, cast it while rolling with Q, just before you reach him. Follow with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, then activate W Defensive Ball Curl and land basic attacks once Fiddlesticks starts hitting you.
Fiddlesticks.escape: Once Fiddlesticks Q Terrify and E Reap’s silence are down, approach with Rammus Q Powerball and look for a chance to use E Frenzying Taunt. If Fiddlesticks starts W Bountiful Harvest, interrupt the channel with the Q or E you have held in reserve.
Fiddlesticks.fight: If Fiddlesticks appears without R Crowstorm or starts W Bountiful Harvest, approach with Rammus Q Powerball and interrupt the channel with E Frenzying Taunt. If Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm has landed, leave its area instead of continuing to trade there. Activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl after Fiddlesticks actually starts hitting you.
Fiddlesticks.laning: Rammus is weak at clearing camps and dealing damage alone early, so don’t get caught up in farming contests. Once Rammus Q Powerball and E Frenzying Taunt are available, roll Q in advance from out of vision to look for ganks and chances to contest objectives. If Fiddlesticks has been missing for a while, secure vision in the bushes behind the lanes and along objective entrances. If there’s no opening, use Q to leave.
Fiddlesticks.phase: Early on, Rammus clears camps slowly and deals little damage, so look for ganks after Rammus Q Powerball and E Frenzying Taunt are available. In the mid to late game, Rammus’s damage rises as you build defensive items, and in the late game you can apply pressure by taking down turrets.
Fiddlesticks.teamfight: Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest, E Reap, and R Crowstorm hit in an area, so spread out from your allies and don’t group up to enter narrow paths without vision. If you see Fiddlesticks channeling R Crowstorm or using W Bountiful Harvest, look for a chance to interrupt with Rammus Q Powerball, E Frenzying Taunt, or R Soaring Slam. If you can’t reach Fiddlesticks, use Q’s knockback and E’s taunt in front of your team’s main damage dealer to counter incoming engages.

Shyvana.laning: Pressure Shyvana early before she builds stacks of P Scalemail. Look for objectives when Shyvana’s Fury bar is empty; if it’s full, don’t start an objective in front of her.
Shyvana.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, Shyvana E Molten Burst, and Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent. You can build Spirit Visage or Banshee’s Veil early, and get armor against her basic attack physical damage too. Resistance can’t block the true damage from Shyvana Q Emberstrike, but it also deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid building a lot of health alone.
Shyvana.combo: Start rolling Rammus Q Powerball from out of vision to build speed, and approach Shyvana while avoiding minions and neutral monsters. To knock her up, cast Rammus R Soaring Slam while rolling, just before reaching Shyvana, then use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt after landing. When Shyvana starts attacking you, activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl and basic attack.
Shyvana.escape: After Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent is down or her transformation ends, Shyvana has no way to create distance on her own, so look for an opportunity to engage. If she comes in with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent, catch her with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt after she lands.
Shyvana.fight: Look for an opening when Shyvana’s fury bar is empty or after the transformation from Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent ends. Close in with Rammus Q Powerball and use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, then activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl when Shyvana starts attacking you. Don’t use crowd control while Shyvana is flying with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent; wait for her to land.
Shyvana.phase: Rammus grows stronger with defensive items in the mid to late game, but Shyvana also builds permanent stacks. If you give up your early advantage, it becomes harder to catch her with the same engage.
Shyvana.teamfight: Spread out with your allies so several people aren’t hit together by Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent’s path, Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, and Shyvana E Molten Burst. If Shyvana flies in with Rammus R Soaring Slam, wait for her to land, then catch her with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt or Rammus Q Powerball. If you can’t taunt the enemy backline’s main damage dealer, counter Shyvana’s engage in front of your allied carry.
Shyvana.watch: Shyvana E Molten Burst and Shyvana Q Emberstrike deal damage based on your maximum health, so don’t try to survive by building health alone. Also be wary of prolonged fights against the shield and healing from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis while taking repeated empowered basic attacks from Shyvana Q Emberstrike. Shyvana is unstoppable while flying with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent, so don’t try to interrupt her engage; use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt after she lands.

Brand.build: Build magic resistance before armor to prepare for Brand’s damage. You can buy Spirit Visage or Banshee’s Veil earlier, and Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl also increases magic resistance. Brand P Blaze deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that only greatly increase your health.
Brand.combo: Roll Rammus Q Powerball from out of sight ahead of time to build speed. When using Rammus R Soaring Slam, cast it while rolling just before reaching Brand to knock up enemies at the center. Follow with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, and when Brand starts attacking, activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl and land basic attacks.
Brand.escape: Brand has no mobility skill, so the moment after Brand W Pillar of Flame is down is an opening to engage. If you’re ablaze, dodge Brand Q Sear’s stun first, then engage. If Brand Q Sear is also down, close the distance with Rammus Q Powerball and use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt.
Brand.fight: Close the distance after Brand W Pillar of Flame is down. Brand has no mobility skill, so he’ll have trouble escaping if you approach with Rammus Q Powerball and use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. Activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl after Brand actually starts attacking Rammus.
Brand.laning: Rammus clears camps slowly early on, so look for gank opportunities after Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt are available instead of contesting farm. Avoid standing near minions set ablaze by Brand, and look to engage when Brand W Pillar of Flame is down. If you don’t have an angle, escape with Rammus Q Powerball.
Brand.phase: Rammus clears camps slowly early on and deals little damage on his own, so look for gank angles instead of forcing fights into Brand’s poke. Rammus’s damage also rises in the mid to late game as he builds defensive items, and he can pressure by taking down turrets later on.
Brand.teamfight: Before engaging, spread out from your allies to reduce the spread from Brand E Conflagration and the bounces from Brand R Pyroclasm. If you can reach Brand, approach with Rammus Q Powerball, catch him with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, and place Rammus R Soaring Slam where Brand will have to pass through. If you’re in a position where it’s hard to catch Brand, stand in front of your main damage dealer and use Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt to counter the enemy engage.
Brand.watch: Dodge Brand W Pillar of Flame and Brand Q Sear first to make it easier to prevent Blaze stacks and an explosion. If you’re ablaze, move out of the line of Brand Q Sear or hide behind a minion to avoid its stun. When you see Brand R Pyroclasm being cast, move away from your allies.

Briar.build: Build armor first, considering the main damage from Briar P Crimson Curse, Briar Q Head Rush, and Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Briar E Chilling Scream and Briar R Certain Death deal magic damage, so build magic resistance too if needed. If the duel goes on, consider Grievous Wounds after building resistances.
Briar.combo: Roll Rammus Q Powerball from out of sight ahead of time, then collide with Briar to knock her back and slow her. Follow with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, and when Briar starts attacking, activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl and land basic attacks. To aim for a knock-up with Rammus R Soaring Slam, cast it while rolling just before reaching Briar.
Briar.escape: Don’t engage just because either Briar Q Head Rush or Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack is down. If several of Briar’s mobility skills are down, especially before Briar R Certain Death comes back up, close the distance with Rammus R Soaring Slam, then catch her with Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt.
Briar.fight: When Briar dives in with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, stand in front so you become the closer target instead of a back-line damage dealer. Once Briar actually starts attacking Rammus, activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl, and interrupt Briar E Chilling Scream’s charge with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. If you don’t have an angle, escape with Rammus Q Powerball along a path that won’t collide with an enemy or minion.
Briar.laning: Instead of contesting farm early, Rammus should focus on clearing camps and using Rammus Q Powerball’s long engage range for ganks and objective fights. Roll Rammus Q Powerball from out of sight ahead of time to build speed, and counter Briar’s reckless engages with vision established.
Briar.phase: Rammus’s damage also rises in the mid to late game as he builds defensive items, and he can pressure turrets later on.
Briar.teamfight: Stand in front in the direction Briar dives with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack to protect your back-line damage dealers. Use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt to interrupt Briar’s engage or her Briar E Chilling Scream charge, and use Rammus R Soaring Slam in a narrow path or objective pit Briar has to cross. If you can’t taunt the enemy main damage dealer, stand in front of your allies’ damage dealers and use Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt to counter the engage.
Briar.watch: Briar Q Head Rush stuns and reduces armor and magic resistance, so adjust your distance to avoid it. When Briar starts charging E Chilling Scream, interrupt it with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. Don’t fight with your back to a wall, so a fully charged scream can’t knock you into it and stun you. If Briar R Certain Death’s bloodstone hits you and marks you as prey, move toward your allies and fight back together instead of running alone.

Diana.build: Diana deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. You can buy Spirit Visage or Banshee’s Veil earlier, and Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl also increases magic resistance.
Diana.combo: Roll Rammus Q Powerball from out of sight ahead of time to build speed, then use Rammus R Soaring Slam while rolling just before reaching Diana. Catch her with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt after landing, and when Diana starts attacking, activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl and land basic attacks. If Rammus Q Powerball collides first and stops, Rammus R Soaring Slam’s center knock-up won’t apply.
Diana.escape: The moment after Diana uses E Lunar Rush without a Q Crescent Strike mark is an opening to engage. Close the distance with Rammus R Soaring Slam, then catch her with Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. If Diana Q Crescent Strike hits you, Diana E Lunar Rush may reset, so don’t engage; create distance instead.
Diana.fight: If Diana engages first with E Lunar Rush without using Q Crescent Strike, she has no way to return, so catch her with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. If she has marked you, prioritize creating distance over chasing. Fight after the orbs and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade are gone, and activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl right after you start taking attacks.
Diana.laning: Rammus clears camps slowly early on and deals little damage on his own, so look for gank angles after Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt are available instead of contesting farm. Counter Diana with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt when she dives under your turret.
Diana.phase: The mid to late game is a strong period for Rammus as he builds defensive items, and he can also pressure by taking down turrets later on.
Diana.teamfight: Watch Diana’s engage angle and spread out while holding side vision so several allies aren’t pulled in by Diana R Moonfall. Use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt to interrupt Diana’s engage or catch the enemy main damage dealer. Place Rammus R Soaring Slam in a narrow path or objective pit the enemy has to cross. If it’s hard to catch a target with taunt, stand in front of your allies and use Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt to counter the engage.
Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike curves as it flies, so sidestep it. If it hits and marks you, Diana E Lunar Rush may reset, so move away and create distance. Don’t approach right after Diana activates W Pale Cascade; fight after its orbs and shield disappear.

Ekko.build: Build magic resistance and buy Spirit Visage or Banshee’s Veil earlier to withstand Ekko’s magic damage. Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl also increases magic resistance, so don’t stack only armor.
Ekko.combo: When engaging Ekko, roll with Rammus Q Powerball and use Rammus R Soaring Slam just before collision to knock up enemies at the center. Follow with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, and when Ekko starts attacking Rammus, activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl and land basic attacks. If Rammus Q Powerball collides and stops, you won’t get the knock-up from Rammus R Soaring Slam.
Ekko.escape: Start the main fight after both Ekko W Parallel Convergence and Ekko R Chronobreak are down. If Ekko has just used Ekko E Phase Dive too, that’s an opportunity to close in with Rammus Q Powerball and use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. If only Ekko E Phase Dive is down, account for Ekko R Chronobreak as a way for him to escape.
Ekko.fight: Catch Ekko with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt right after he closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive. Stay out of the marked area of Ekko W Parallel Convergence, and if Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, don’t chase deep based only on health.
Ekko.laning: Rammus is weak at clearing camps and dealing damage on his own early, so look for gank angles while clearing camps instead of contesting farm. Once both Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt are available, engage by rolling Rammus Q Powerball from out of sight ahead of time. If you don’t have an angle, escape with Rammus Q Powerball.
Ekko.phase: Rammus is weak early, so focus on camps and ganks instead of forcing direct fights. The mid to late game is Rammus’s peak as he builds defensive items, and he can also pressure by taking down turrets later on.
Ekko.teamfight: Catch Ekko with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt right after he engages with Ekko E Phase Dive to protect your allies. Use Rammus R Soaring Slam in a narrow path or objective pit Ekko has to pass through, not where he has already left. If it’s hard to catch a target with taunt, stand in front of your allies’ main damage dealer and use Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt to counter the engage.
Ekko.watch: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, leave the marked area. This can prevent both its stun and Ekko gaining a shield. Also sidestep the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder. If you see Ekko’s afterimage behind him, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, so don’t chase recklessly even when health is low.

Elise.build: Build magic resistance first against Elise’s main damage, and also get armor to account for her basic attack damage. You can buy Spirit Visage or Banshee’s Veil earlier, and consider tenacity too if there’s a high risk of being caught by Cocoon.
Elise.combo: Roll Rammus Q Powerball from out of sight ahead of time to build speed, and use Rammus R Soaring Slam just before reaching Elise to knock up enemies at the center. After landing, use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, and when Elise starts attacking, activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl and land basic attacks.
Elise.escape: The moment after you bait Elise into using Elise Q Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite is an opportunity to close the distance. Especially if Elise E Cocoon / Rappel’s Cocoon and Elise E Rappel are also down, approach with Rammus R Soaring Slam and catch her with Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. Don’t use taunt while she is airborne with E Rappel; wait for her to land.
Elise.fight: Fight when both Elise E Cocoon / Rappel’s Cocoon and Elise E Rappel are down. Approach with Rammus Q Powerball and catch her with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. When Elise starts attacking Rammus, activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl.
Elise.laning: Elise is strong at ganking early, so maintain ample vision and don’t push the lane recklessly when she’s missing. Rammus is weak at clearing camps and dealing damage on his own early, so gank once Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt are available.
Elise.phase: Early on, focus on watching for Elise’s ganks and not giving up kills. Rammus’s damage also rises in the mid to late game as he builds defensive items, and he can pressure by taking down turrets later on.
Elise.teamfight: If you can reach the enemy back line, catch its main damage dealer with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. Engage with Rammus Q Powerball during the opening after Elise E Cocoon / Rappel is down, and use Rammus R Soaring Slam while rolling to control the landing area.
Elise.watch: If Elise E Cocoon / Rappel’s Cocoon hits you, she can also engage you in R Spider Form while you’re stunned.

Evelynn.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Evelynn Q Hate Spike, Evelynn W Allure, and Evelynn E Whiplash. Buy Spirit Visage or Banshee’s Veil earlier instead of stacking only armor or greatly increasing only your health. However, Evelynn W Allure lowers magic resistance, so retreating before the mark matures takes priority.
Evelynn.combo: Roll Rammus Q Powerball from out of sight ahead of time, and to knock Evelynn airborne, cast Rammus R Soaring Slam while rolling just before colliding with her. Follow with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, and when Evelynn starts attacking, activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl and land basic attacks.
Evelynn.escape: Don’t engage just because Evelynn E Whiplash is down; she can escape with Evelynn R Last Caress. Especially before Evelynn R Last Caress comes back up, dodge the charm from Evelynn W Allure, then close the distance with Rammus R Soaring Slam and catch her with Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt.
Evelynn.fight: Keep your distance before the mark from Evelynn W Allure matures to avoid the charm. When fighting, roll Rammus Q Powerball from out of sight ahead of time to build speed before engaging, and activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl when Evelynn starts attacking Rammus.
Evelynn.laning: Rammus clears camps slowly early on, so focus on ganks and objective fights once Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt are available instead of contesting farm. Ward near Evelynn’s jungle camps and at the actual fight location, and alert your allies immediately when you see the mark from Evelynn W Allure.
Evelynn.phase: In the mid to late game, Rammus’s damage also rises as he builds defensive items, so focus on ganks and objective fights. If a late game teamfight stalls, Rammus can pressure turrets with Rammus R Soaring Slam and basic attacks.
Evelynn.teamfight: Evelynn targets back-line damage dealers, so protect them from the front where your team has vision and hold Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. If Evelynn engages, knock her back with Rammus Q Powerball and catch her with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. If an opening to engage Evelynn appears, dive onto her with Rammus R Soaring Slam while rolling to knock her up, then leave the aftershock on the path she must take through your landing area.
Evelynn.watch: If the mark from Evelynn W Allure appears, retreat before the charm lands and alert your allies.

Gragas.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Gragas Q Barrel Roll, W Drunken Rage, and E Body Slam. You can get Spirit Visage or Banshee’s Veil early, and Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl also increases magic resistance. Gragas W Drunken Rage deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that only greatly increase health.
Gragas.combo: Once Gragas E Body Slam is down, approach with Rammus Q Powerball. To knock him up, cast Rammus R Soaring Slam while rolling, just before you collide with him, then catch him with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt after landing. Activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl and use basic attacks once the opponent starts hitting you.
Gragas.escape: The moment Gragas’s mobility skill, E Body Slam, is down is your chance to engage. Close the gap with Rammus R Soaring Slam, then follow with Rammus Q Powerball and E Frenzying Taunt. If Gragas E Body Slam is still available, avoid chasing too deep.
Gragas.fight: If Gragas starts drinking with W Drunken Rage, attack after its damage reduction ends. Immediately after baiting out Gragas E Body Slam, close the gap with Rammus R Soaring Slam and catch him with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. Activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl once the opponent actually starts hitting you.
Gragas.laning: Rammus is better off clearing camps and looking for ganks and objective plays than competing to farm early. Roll Rammus Q Powerball in advance from out of vision to build speed, and choose a path that won’t make you stop against minions. If there’s no gank opening, use Rammus Q Powerball to leave.
Gragas.phase: Early on, Rammus clears camps slowly and deals little damage alone, while Gragas is strong at burst damage and disrupting formations in the early to mid game. In the mid to late game, Rammus’s damage rises as you build defensive items, and in the late game you can apply pressure by taking down turrets.
Gragas.teamfight: Protect your back line so allies don’t stand alone within range of Gragas E Body Slam, and watch which way Gragas R Explosive Cask could scatter your formation. If you can reach the enemy back line’s main damage dealer, engage with Rammus Q Powerball and pin them with E Frenzying Taunt. If there’s no opening, stay in front of your carry and use Rammus Q Powerball’s knockback and E Frenzying Taunt to counter Gragas’s engage.
Gragas.watch: If you see Gragas Q Barrel Roll, move outside its radius before it explodes. If Gragas hits you with E Body Slam near the barrel, you can easily take both attacks, so move away from the barrel even after being knocked up. When Gragas has R Explosive Cask available, don’t stand with your back to the enemy team or an enemy tower.

Graves.build: Get Plated Steelcaps first, then build armor. Graves’s main damage is physical, and the armor from Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl helps you survive. Armor does not block the magic damage from Graves W Smoke Screen.
Graves.combo: Roll Rammus Q Powerball in advance from out of vision to build speed. Just before reaching Graves, cast Rammus R Soaring Slam while rolling to knock up enemies in the center, then use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. Activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl and use basic attacks once Graves starts hitting you.
Graves.escape: Prioritize an opening before Graves R Collateral Damage comes back. If Graves E Quickdraw is down too, close the gap with Rammus R Soaring Slam and pin him with Rammus Q Powerball and E Frenzying Taunt. If you’re inside Graves W Smoke Screen, leave its area first to recover your vision.
Graves.fight: Counterattack or close the gap while Graves reloads after firing two shots. When approaching, put minions or allies between you and Graves to block Graves P New Destiny’s basic attacks, and choose a path that won’t make Rammus Q Powerball stop against minions. Activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl once Graves starts hitting you.
Graves.laning: Once Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt are available, roll in advance from out of vision to pressure with ganks. Focus on early lane pressure and objective plays to limit the time Graves has to build stacks on E Quickdraw.
Graves.phase: As the game goes on, Graves’s stacks make him harder to deal with, but Rammus’s damage also rises as you build defensive items, so in the late game also apply pressure by attacking turrets.
Graves.teamfight: If Graves is the main damage dealer, use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt to redirect his basic attacks toward Rammus, then activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl when he actually starts hitting you. Place the aftershock from Rammus R Soaring Slam in a narrow path Graves must cross or in an objective pit. If there’s no opening to taunt him, stand in front of your team’s main damage dealer and use Rammus Q Powerball’s knockback and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt to counter the engage.
Graves.watch: Graves Q End of the Line detonates as soon as it hits terrain, so don’t fight with your back to a wall. If Graves traps you in W Smoke Screen, take the shortest path out, recover your vision and movement speed, then re-engage. Graves E Quickdraw and R Collateral Damage are both mobility tools, so don’t engage immediately just because one is down.

Hecarim.build: Hecarim’s main damage from Q Rampage and E Devastating Charge is physical, so build armor first. Hecarim W Spirit of Dread and R Onslaught of Shadows deal magic damage, so build magic resistance too if needed. Rammus also gains attack damage through Rammus P Spiked Shell when you build defensive stats.
Hecarim.combo: Roll Rammus Q Powerball in advance from out of vision to build speed, then approach Hecarim. To knock him up with Rammus R Soaring Slam, cast it while rolling with Q, just before reaching Hecarim and before Q collides and stops. Follow with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, and activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl once Hecarim starts hitting you.
Hecarim.escape: If you engage just because Hecarim E Devastating Charge is down, he can escape with Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows. Look for an opening before Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows comes back, close the gap with Rammus R Soaring Slam, then pin him with Rammus Q Powerball and E Frenzying Taunt.
Hecarim.fight: When a fight starts, disrupt Hecarim’s movement first with the slow from Rammus Q Powerball or E Frenzying Taunt. Hecarim gains attack damage from bonus movement speed, so disrupting his movement reduces both his ability to approach and his damage.
Hecarim.laning: Rammus is weak at clearing camps and dealing damage alone early, so don’t get caught up in farming contests. Look for ganks once Rammus Q Powerball and E Frenzying Taunt are available.
Hecarim.phase: In the mid to late game, Rammus’s damage rises as you build defensive items, and in the late game you can apply pressure by taking down turrets.
Hecarim.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows doesn’t fear multiple people at once. When Hecarim engages, disrupt his movement with Rammus Q Powerball and E Frenzying Taunt, and counter him in front of your team’s main damage dealer. Place the aftershock from Rammus R Soaring Slam in a narrow path Hecarim must cross or in an objective pit.
Hecarim.watch: The farther Hecarim runs with E Devastating Charge, the more damage and knockback it deals. If he runs around to the opposite side, he may be building distance, so break vision or move toward your allies. Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows can fear multiple people, so spread out during team fights.

Ivern.combo: Roll Rammus Q Powerball in advance from out of vision to build speed, and approach while Ivern Q Rootcaller is down. To knock him up, cast Rammus R Soaring Slam while rolling, just before landing, then use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. Activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl and use basic attacks once the opponent starts hitting you.
Ivern.escape: Ivern Q Rootcaller is his mobility tool, so the moment after he uses it is your window to engage. Close the gap with Rammus R Soaring Slam, then pin him with Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. When using Rammus Q Powerball to leave, choose a direction that won’t make you collide with an enemy or minion.
Ivern.fight: Close the gap immediately after forcing Ivern to use Q Rootcaller. If a target is already affected by Ivern E Triggerseed, attack after it explodes, and use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt to pin the key damage dealer. Cut off the allies Ivern shields first instead of chasing him deep.
Ivern.laning: Early on, use vision to track Ivern’s route as he comes to harvest camps he has seeded. Rammus clears camps slowly early, so focus on ganks once Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt are available. Don’t casually walk past newly created Ivern W Brushmaker bushes.
Ivern.phase: Early on, Rammus clears camps slowly and deals little damage alone, so avoid forced fights and look for ganks once Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt are available. In the mid to late game, Rammus’s damage rises as you build defensive stats, and in the late game you can apply pressure by taking down turrets.
Ivern.teamfight: Engage after Ivern E Triggerseed bursts, then pin the enemy back line’s main damage dealer with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. Use the slow from Rammus R Soaring Slam in a narrow path the enemy must cross or in an objective pit. If you can’t reach the main damage dealer, stand in front of your carry and use Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt to counter the enemy engage.
Ivern.watch: If Ivern roots you with Q Rootcaller, his allies can dash in, so stand behind minions or terrain before it’s cast. Don’t attack a target affected by Ivern E Triggerseed until its shield bursts and leaves a slow. If Ivern R Daisy! starts hitting you, move so you don’t get hit three times in a row.
Ivern.build: Ivern’s abilities deal mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance instead of stacking only armor. You can get Spirit Visage or Banshee’s Veil earlier, and consider tenacity first if allies join in after roots and knockups.

JarvanIV.build: Basic attacks and attack speed are the foundation of damage, so effects that reduce attack speed are useful too.
JarvanIV.combo: To knock them up, cast Rammus R Soaring Slam while rolling, just before colliding, then use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt after landing.
JarvanIV.fight: If there’s no opening to engage, use Rammus Q Powerball to leave.
JarvanIV.laning: Rammus spends time clearing camps and looking for ganks and objective plays instead of competing to farm early. Roll Rammus Q Powerball in advance from out of vision, and enter along a path that avoids minions and neutral monsters.

Jax.build: Jax deals both physical and magic damage, so build armor and magic resistance instead of stacking only one type of resistance. Basic attacks and attack speed are the foundation of his damage, so prioritize defensive items that reduce attack speed. Jax E Counter Strike deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that only greatly increase health.
Jax.combo: Once Jax E Counter Strike is down, roll Rammus Q Powerball in advance to approach. When casting Rammus R Soaring Slam, cast it while rolling with Q, just before reaching Jax, to aim for the knockup in the center. Follow with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, then activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl and use basic attacks once Jax starts hitting you.
Jax.escape: Don’t spend Rammus Q Powerball or Rammus R Soaring Slam just because Jax starts the animation for E Counter Strike. When Counter Strike ends or just after Jax uses Q Leap Strike, close the gap with Rammus R Soaring Slam, then pin him with Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. If there’s no opening, leave with Q along a path that won’t make you stop against minions or enemies.
Jax.fight: Don’t basic attack while Jax E Counter Strike is active; move out of its stun radius. The chance to engage comes when Counter Strike ends or just after Jax uses Q Leap Strike. Approach with Rammus Q Powerball and pin him with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, then activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl once Jax actually starts hitting you.
Jax.laning: Once Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt are available, roll in advance from out of vision and look for ganks while Jax E Counter Strike is down.
Jax.watch: When Jax E Counter Strike is active, basic attacks are dodged, and its recast damage grows with each attack dodged. Stop using basic attacks and move outside the stun radius until it ends. When Jax comes in with Q Leap Strike, watch out for Counter Strike’s area stun as well.

Karthus.build: Karthus deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance before armor. You can get Spirit Visage or Banshee’s Veil early, and Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl also increases magic resistance. Still, prioritize avoiding Karthus W Wall of Pain and leaving Karthus E Defile’s area.
Karthus.combo: Roll Rammus Q Powerball in advance from out of vision to build speed, then approach Karthus. To knock enemies in the center up with Rammus R Soaring Slam, cast it while rolling, just before reaching Karthus and before colliding and stopping. Follow with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, then activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl and use basic attacks once Karthus starts hitting you.
Karthus.escape: Karthus has no ability to create distance or immobilize you, so you can look for an engage once Rammus Q Powerball and E Frenzying Taunt are available. If Karthus W Wall of Pain is in place, approach along a route that doesn’t cross it. When leaving, choose an open path so Rammus Q Powerball doesn’t stop against an enemy or minion.
Karthus.fight: Karthus has no ability to create distance, so you can close the gap with Rammus Q Powerball and use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. Avoid routes through Karthus W Wall of Pain, and activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl just after Karthus starts hitting you. Even if you kill him, don’t keep fighting near his corpse.
Karthus.laning: Rammus is better off clearing camps and looking for ganks and objective plays than competing to farm early. If there’s no opening to engage, use Rammus Q Powerball to leave.
Karthus.phase: If you don’t stop Karthus from scaling, he catches up through fast farming, so use Rammus R Soaring Slam to join objective fights in the mid game. In the mid to late game, Rammus’s damage rises as you build defensive items, and in the late game you can apply pressure by taking down turrets.
Karthus.teamfight: If Karthus enters Rammus E Frenzying Taunt’s range, interrupt his ability use with the taunt, and cast Rammus R Soaring Slam where Karthus stays or must pass through. Even after you kill Karthus, he can still deal damage during Karthus P Death Defied, so reposition immediately. If you can’t reach Karthus, don’t force an engage; stay in front of your allies and use Rammus Q Powerball and E Frenzying Taunt to stop enemies who engage.
Karthus.watch: Passing through Karthus W Wall of Pain reduces your magic resistance and slows you, making the following Karthus Q Lay Waste and R Requiem hurt more. Move outside the wall and don’t stay in Karthus E Defile’s area for long. Even right after you kill Karthus, he can cast abilities near his corpse with Karthus P Death Defied, so leave immediately.

Kayn.build: Build armor first to reduce the physical damage from Kayn Q Reaping Slash, W Blade's Reach, and R Umbral Trespass. Rammus P Spiked Shell also increases your attack damage as your defensive stats rise. If Kayn transforms into the Darkin Slayer and the fight drags on because of his healing, build resistances first, then consider Grievous Wounds.
Kayn.combo: Start rolling Rammus Q Powerball from out of vision to build speed, then cast Rammus R Soaring Slam while still rolling just before you reach Kayn. After landing, use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. When Kayn starts attacking you, activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl and use basic attacks. Once Rammus Q Powerball collides and stops, you can no longer aim for the knockup from Rammus R Soaring Slam.
Kayn.escape: Don’t engage just because Kayn Q Reaping Slash is down. Your chance to go in is before Kayn R Umbral Trespass comes back up, especially after dodging Kayn W Blade's Reach. Use Rammus R Soaring Slam to close in, then follow with Q Powerball and E Frenzying Taunt to keep Kayn from escaping.
Kayn.fight: Use Rammus R Soaring Slam to close the gap before Kayn R Umbral Trespass comes back up. Follow with Rammus Q Powerball and E Frenzying Taunt to stop Kayn from escaping. Activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl just after Kayn starts attacking you.
Kayn.laning: Rammus is weak at clearing camps and competing for farm early, so clear your camps and wait until you have Rammus Q Powerball and E Frenzying Taunt before looking to join ganks. Kayn is weak before transforming, so pressure his early jungle path and join objective fights to delay his transformation. If you see the warning at the edge of a wall that signals Kayn E Shadow Step, stop fighting and retreat toward your turret.
Kayn.phase: Mid to late game is a strong phase for Rammus as his defensive stats build up, and in the late game you can apply pressure by taking down turrets.
Kayn.teamfight: If Kayn goes on an ally, use the knockback from Rammus Q Powerball and E Frenzying Taunt to counter-engage. An ally inside Kayn R Umbral Trespass can’t be helped while Kayn is inside them, so prepare crowd control around the target and interrupt Kayn as soon as he emerges. If you have an opening to reach the enemy’s main damage dealer, engage with Rammus Q Powerball, use E Frenzying Taunt, and hold them in place with the aftershock from R Soaring Slam.
Kayn.watch: Dodge the line of Kayn W Blade's Reach. Kayn R Umbral Trespass can only target someone he has damaged, so it’s important not to get hit by Kayn W Blade's Reach from long range. Kayn Q Reaping Slash deals damage based on your maximum health. If Kayn enters a wall with Kayn E Shadow Step, watch for the warning at the edge and retreat toward your turret.

Khazix.build: Build armor first to reduce Kha'Zix’s main damage. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat, but Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl increases both your armor and magic resistance.
Khazix.combo: Start rolling Rammus Q Powerball from out of vision to build speed, then collide with Kha'Zix and catch him with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. When Kha'Zix starts attacking, activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl and use basic attacks. To aim for a knockup, cast Rammus R Soaring Slam while rolling with Q, just before you reach Kha'Zix.
Khazix.escape: Engage just after Kha'Zix E Leap is down. Close the gap with Rammus R Soaring Slam, then catch Kha'Zix with Rammus Q Powerball and E Frenzying Taunt. After an ally is killed, Kha'Zix’s evolved E Leap may reset, so reassess whether you can counterattack.
Khazix.fight: Look to counterattack just after Kha'Zix uses E Leap to engage. Catch him with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, and activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl when Kha'Zix starts attacking you.
Khazix.laning: Your camp clear is slow early, so focus on ganks and joining objective fights once you have Rammus Q Powerball and E Frenzying Taunt instead of competing for farm. Spend less time alone so Kha'Zix can’t isolate you, and secure vision around the river and jungle entrance bushes.
Khazix.phase: Once Kha'Zix has two or more evolutions in the mid game, stop acting alone and move with your allies. Rammus gets stronger in the mid to late game as his defensive items build up, and can also apply pressure by taking down turrets in the late game.
Khazix.teamfight: Stay beside your allied damage dealers to deny Kha'Zix an isolation angle, and counter-engage with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt if he comes in with Kha'Zix E Leap. Group up and secure vision before objectives, and use Rammus R Soaring Slam in a narrow path Kha'Zix has to cross.
Khazix.watch: Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear deals more damage when you’re isolated, so stay near allies or minions. If Kha'Zix disappears with R Void Assault, stay with your allies instead of chasing his position, then use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt as soon as he reappears.

LeeSin.build: Build armor first because Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike and R Dragon's Rage deal mostly physical damage. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Lee Sin E Tempest / Cripple. If you take many basic attacks, consider a way to reduce attack speed; if a fight drags on because of the healing from Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will, consider Grievous Wounds.
LeeSin.combo: Start rolling Rammus Q Powerball from out of vision to build speed, then cast Rammus R Soaring Slam while still rolling just before you reach Lee Sin to knock up enemies in the center. Follow with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt to catch him. When Lee Sin starts attacking you, activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl and use basic attacks.
LeeSin.escape: Your chance to engage is before Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike comes back up. If Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will is still available, don’t go in just because Q is down. If the gap is large, close it with Rammus R Soaring Slam, then use Rammus Q Powerball and E Frenzying Taunt to stop him from escaping.
LeeSin.fight: Avoid dueling Lee Sin if you run into him in the early jungle. Look to engage when Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike misses or can’t be used again yet, but keep in mind that Lee Sin can also escape with W Safeguard / Iron Will. Just after Lee Sin uses W to engage, catch him with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. Activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl once he actually starts attacking you.
LeeSin.laning: Clear your camps early and avoid direct clashes with Lee Sin. After you have Rammus Q Powerball and E Frenzying Taunt, start rolling Q from out of vision before looking for a gank. Tell the ally being ganked to keep minions between them and Lee Sin to remove the angle for Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike.
LeeSin.phase: Lee Sin is strong in early duels, so back off and look for camp and gank opportunities. Rammus’s damage also increases in the mid to late game as his defensive items build up, and you can apply pressure by taking down turrets in the late game.
LeeSin.teamfight: If you can reach the enemy’s main damage dealer, engage with Rammus Q Powerball and lock them down with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. If it’s hard to engage, counter Lee Sin’s engage in front of your allies with the knockback from Rammus Q Powerball and E Frenzying Taunt. Keep your distance from allies so you don’t collide with someone knocked back by Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage.
LeeSin.watch: In teamfights, watch where Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage could knock you and keep your distance from allies.

Lillia.build: Build magic resistance first to reduce Lillia’s main damage, and also get armor so you can withstand physical damage. You can buy Spirit Visage or Banshee's Veil earlier. Resistances don’t work against the true damage from Lillia Q Blooming Blows, but Lillia P Dream-Laden Bough deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about stacking only health.
Lillia.combo: If Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! is down, start rolling Rammus Q Powerball from out of vision to close in. To knock her up, cast Rammus R Soaring Slam while rolling just before you reach Lillia, then use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. When Lillia starts attacking you, activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl and use basic attacks.
Lillia.escape: Your chance to engage is just after Lillia uses W Watch Out! Eep! Dodge her abilities to prevent her from building movement speed stacks, then close the gap with Rammus R Soaring Slam and catch her with Rammus Q Powerball and E Frenzying Taunt. If Lillia R Lilting Lullaby affects you, stop your engage and move to a safe place while you can still act before falling asleep.
Lillia.fight: Don’t force a chase while Lillia has movement speed stacks from landing her abilities. Dodge her abilities to prevent her from building stacks, then close the gap right after she uses Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! Once you’re close, lock her down with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, and activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl after Lillia starts attacking you.
Lillia.laning: Rammus is weak at farming and dealing damage alone early, so clear your camps and look for chances to gank and join objective fights. Look to gank once you have both Rammus Q Powerball and E Frenzying Taunt, and start rolling Rammus Q Powerball from out of vision to build speed. When you don’t know where Lillia is, don’t take narrow jungle entrances or river passages where it’s hard to dodge Lillia E Swirlseed.
Lillia.phase: In the mid to late game, defensive items also increase Rammus’s damage, and you can apply pressure by taking down turrets in the late game.
Lillia.watch: If Lillia Q Blooming Blows or E Swirlseed hits you, it enables Lillia R Lilting Lullaby to put you to sleep, so dodge them even if your health is high. When you see Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! winding up, move to the side to leave the center. If you’re affected by the sleep, move to a safe place while you can still act before falling asleep.

MasterYi.build: Build health to withstand the true damage from Master Yi E Wuju Style, and consider a way to reduce attack speed to slow his basic attacks and the cooldown rotation of Master Yi Q Alpha Strike.
MasterYi.combo: After Master Yi uses Q Alpha Strike, roll in with Rammus Q Powerball and cast Rammus R Soaring Slam before colliding to aim for a knockup at the center of the area. Once Master Yi lands and can be targeted, use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. When he starts basic attacking you, activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl.
MasterYi.escape: Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is a movement tool, so your window to engage is just after you make him use it. When Master Yi lands, use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt to keep him from escaping. You can also close the gap with Rammus R Soaring Slam.
MasterYi.fight: Look to engage once you have Rammus Q Powerball and E Frenzying Taunt. When Master Yi starts attacking you, activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl and fight back with basic attacks.
MasterYi.laning: Instead of fixating on competing for farm early, clear your camps and join ganks and objective fights once you have Rammus Q Powerball and E Frenzying Taunt. Take advantage while Master Yi’s early jungle and ganking are weak. If there’s no opening to engage, retreat with Rammus Q Powerball.
MasterYi.phase: Rammus’s defensive stats also add to his damage in the mid to late game, but Master Yi also gets stronger as the game goes on, so don’t delay gaining an early advantage.
MasterYi.teamfight: Move with your allies so Master Yi can’t get the first takedown contribution. Right after Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends, lock him down with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. If Master Yi uses W Meditate, interrupt his channel with Taunt. If there’s no way to engage and taunt him, counter his engage in front of your team’s main damage dealer with Rammus Q Powerball and E Frenzying Taunt.
MasterYi.watch: Master Yi can’t be targeted while using Q Alpha Strike, so use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt right after Master Yi lands. If Master Yi R Highlander is active, slows won’t work, so don’t rely on the slow from Rammus Q Powerball to create distance. Armor can’t block the true damage from Master Yi E Wuju Style.

MonkeyKing.build: Build armor first to reduce Wukong’s main damage. Wukong E Nimbus Strike deals magic damage, so make use of the magic resistance from Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl too. Wukong Q Crushing Blow reduces your armor and Wukong R Cyclone deals damage based on your maximum health, so consider reducing attack speed instead of stacking only health.
MonkeyKing.combo: While Wukong W Warrior Trickster is down, roll in with Rammus Q Powerball and cast Rammus R Soaring Slam just before colliding to knock up Wukong at the center of the area. Follow with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt on the real Wukong and use basic attacks. When Wukong starts attacking you, activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl.
MonkeyKing.escape: Your chance to engage is after Wukong W Warrior Trickster is down and before it comes back up. If Wukong E Nimbus Strike is also down, he has fewer ways to escape, so catch him with Rammus Q Powerball and E Frenzying Taunt. Right after Wukong uses R Cyclone is also a good time to start a fight or objective contest.
MonkeyKing.fight: Rammus’s magic damage hits Wukong hard because Wukong has low magic resistance, so fight back when you’re close, but don’t let the fight drag on. Wukong gains armor and healing as he attacks, so trade briefly and back off. You can engage with Rammus R Soaring Slam to close the gap before Wukong W Warrior Trickster comes back up.
MonkeyKing.laning: Rammus clears camps slowly early and deals little damage alone, so spend your time on ganks and joining objective fights instead of competing for farm. Look to gank once you have both Rammus Q Powerball and E Frenzying Taunt, and start rolling Rammus Q Powerball from out of vision to build speed. If there’s no opening, retreat with Rammus Q Powerball.
MonkeyKing.phase: Rammus clears camps slowly and deals little damage alone early, but Wukong has low magic resistance and is vulnerable to Rammus’s damage. Rammus’s damage also increases in the mid to late game as defensive items build up, and you can apply pressure by taking down turrets in the late game.
MonkeyKing.teamfight: If Wukong R Cyclone is available, keep your distance from allies so it can’t knock up several of you at once. If Wukong engages, protect your team’s main damage dealer with the knockback from Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt.
MonkeyKing.watch: Wukong E Nimbus Strike is targeted, so you can’t dodge it while you’re in range, and the following Wukong Q Crushing Blow reduces your armor. When Wukong W Warrior Trickster appears, don’t use abilities on the clone left in place; watch which way the real Wukong will retreat.

Nidalee.build: Nidalee’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Don’t stack only armor; buy Spirit Visage or Banshee's Veil earlier. Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl also increases your magic resistance, which helps when taking Nidalee’s attacks.
Nidalee.combo: While rolling with Rammus Q Powerball, cast Rammus R Soaring Slam just before reaching the target to knock them up. Follow with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt on Nidalee. When Nidalee starts attacking, activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl and use basic attacks. Follow the order: once Rammus Q Powerball hits Nidalee and stops, the knockup from Rammus R Soaring Slam is no longer available.
Nidalee.escape: Nidalee has no crowd control, so treat the moment after Nidalee W Pounce is down as your chance to engage. Close the gap with Rammus R Soaring Slam, then use Rammus Q Powerball and E Frenzying Taunt. If there’s no opening, retreat with Rammus Q Powerball along a path without enemies or minions so you don’t stop along the way.
Nidalee.fight: Your chance to close the gap is just after Nidalee uses W Pounce. Approach with Rammus R Soaring Slam, then catch her with Rammus Q Powerball and E Frenzying Taunt. When Nidalee starts attacking you, activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl.
Nidalee.laning: Rammus clears camps slowly early, so focus on ganks once you have Rammus Q Powerball and E Frenzying Taunt instead of competing for farm. Start rolling Rammus Q Powerball from out of vision to build speed, and approach while avoiding minions and neutral monsters. When entering the river or a jungle entrance, use a Control Ward or an area ability to check for Nidalee W Bushwhack traps.
Nidalee.phase: Rammus has a weak camp clear and low damage alone early, so avoid forcing fights until you have Rammus Q Powerball and E Frenzying Taunt. In the mid to late game, defensive items also increase Rammus’s damage, and in the late game you can apply pressure by hitting turrets.
Nidalee.teamfight: Remember where Nidalee showed to throw her spear, and use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt to lock her down when you have an opening. You can knock up enemies in the center by casting Rammus R Soaring Slam while using Rammus Q Powerball to engage. If there’s no opening to engage, counter the enemy’s engage in front of your allies with Rammus Q Powerball and E Frenzying Taunt.
Nidalee.watch: Nidalee Q Javelin Toss hurts more the farther it travels, so be especially careful to dodge it when Nidalee is far away. Nidalee Q Javelin Toss and W Bushwhack apply a hunted mark, so also check for traps around the river and jungle entrances. If you’re marked, save Rammus E Frenzying Taunt for when Nidalee comes in with W Pounce.

Nunu.build: Build magic resistance first against Nunu & Willump’s main damage. Their crowd control is also a major threat, so magic resistance and tenacity are a good combination. Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl also increases your magic resistance, so you can build Spirit Visage or Banshee’s Veil early instead of stacking only armor.
Nunu.combo: Start rolling Rammus Q Powerball from out of vision to build speed, and approach while avoiding minions and monsters. Just before reaching Nunu & Willump, cast Rammus R Soaring Slam while rolling to knock up enemies near the center of its area. Follow up with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, then activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl when you start taking attacks.
Nunu.escape: Engage after dodging Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! and leaving the root area of Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage. Nunu & Willump have no ability to create distance on their own, so close the gap with Rammus R Soaring Slam and catch them with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. If there’s no opening, retreat with Rammus Q Powerball along a path that won’t make you stop by hitting an enemy or minion.
Nunu.fight: Early on, Rammus clears camps slowly and deals little damage alone, so avoid forcing trades. Look for an opening to catch Nunu & Willump after dodging their snowball engage or leaving the root area of Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage. Once you’re in range, lock them down with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, then activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl when they start attacking you.
Nunu.laning: Stay alert after a gank, since Nunu & Willump can come back through the river crab. Rammus should clear camps instead of competing to farm early, then look for ganks and objective plays once Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt are available.
Nunu.phase: In the mid to late game, Rammus deals more damage as he builds defensive stats, and he can pressure by taking down turrets in the late game.
Nunu.teamfight: When Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero begins, interrupt the channel with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt to prevent its explosion damage. To engage, use Rammus R Soaring Slam while rolling with Rammus Q Powerball, and make sure the aftershock lands on a path Nunu & Willump must cross or inside an objective pit. If you can’t taunt the enemy backline’s main damage dealer, use Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt to counter their engage in front of your allied carry.
Nunu.watch: Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! rolls in over a long distance from out of vision and knocks you up, so sidestep its path and move toward where Nunu & Willump just were instead of running away as soon as you see it. If Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage hits you, you’ll be rooted shortly after, so leave the area immediately. When Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero begins, interrupt the channel with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt or leave its range.

Poppy.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Poppy Q Hammer Shock, E Heroic Charge, and R Keeper’s Verdict. Rammus P Spiked Shell also converts defensive stats into attack damage, so you don’t need to force offensive items into your build. Don’t spend extra resources on magic resistance just for Poppy.
Poppy.combo: Once Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends and Poppy E Heroic Charge is down, roll in with Rammus Q Powerball. If you want a knockup, cast Rammus R Soaring Slam while rolling, just before reaching your target, then use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt after colliding. Activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl just after Poppy starts attacking you.
Poppy.escape: Right after you make Poppy use E Heroic Charge, close the gap while her movement ability is down. If Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, wait for it to end before engaging with Rammus R Soaring Slam.
Poppy.fight: The opening to engage comes after Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends and immediately after Poppy uses E Heroic Charge. Approach with Rammus Q Powerball, catch her with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, and activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl when she starts attacking you. If you’re hit by the first strike of Poppy Q Hammer Shock, walk out of the remaining area immediately.
Poppy.laning: Rammus should clear camps and spend time on ganks and objectives rather than competing to farm early. When ganking, start rolling Rammus Q Powerball from out of vision and choose a path that won’t make you stop on a minion. If you can step on Poppy P Iron Ambassador’s dropped shield first, you can prevent her from gaining the shield.
Poppy.phase: Early on, Rammus clears camps slowly and deals little damage alone, so look for ganks once Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt are both available. In the late game, you can pressure by attacking turrets when team fights stall.
Poppy.teamfight: If you can engage, use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt on the enemy backline’s main damage dealer, and cast Rammus R Soaring Slam in a narrow path the enemy must cross or inside an objective pit. If reaching the backline is difficult, counter the enemy engage with the knockback from Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt in front of your allied carry.
Poppy.watch: When Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, don’t engage with Rammus R Soaring Slam; wait for the effect to end. Don’t stand with your back to a wall, or Poppy E Heroic Charge can knock you into one and stun you. When Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict starts charging, move sideways out of its path.

RekSai.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Rek’Sai Q Queen’s Wrath / Prey Seeker, Rek’Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel, and Rek’Sai R Void Rush. Resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Rek’Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel, but Rek’Sai R Void Rush scales with your maximum health, so avoid building a large amount of health alone. Since Rek’Sai relies on basic attacks and attack speed for damage, reducing her attack speed is also effective.
RekSai.combo: Start rolling Rammus Q Powerball from out of vision to build speed. Just before reaching Rek’Sai, cast Rammus R Soaring Slam while rolling to knock up enemies near the center. Follow with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, then activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl and basic attack when Rek’Sai starts attacking. Follow this order, because Rammus R Soaring Slam can’t knock enemies up after Rammus Q Powerball stops on collision.
RekSai.escape: If you dodge the knockup from Rek’Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, she loses her way to catch you, creating an opportunity to engage. If only Rek’Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel is down, she can still escape with Rek’Sai R Void Rush, so look for an opening especially before Rek’Sai R Void Rush comes back up. At that point, close the gap with Rammus R Soaring Slam, then chain Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt.
RekSai.fight: After dodging the knockup from Rek’Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, engage when you see whether she can escape with Rek’Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel and Rek’Sai R Void Rush. Once you’re in range, lock her down with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, then activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl when she actually starts attacking. If Rek’Sai burrows to heal, don’t give her space; keep dealing damage.
RekSai.laning: Early on, avoid pushing your lane too far and don’t cross areas without vision alone, so Rek’Sai can’t get kills with ganks. Step on Rek’Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel entrances visible near a lane or your allied jungle to remove them. Rammus should clear camps rather than compete to farm early, and use Rammus Q Powerball to join ganks and objective fights.
RekSai.phase: Buy time to build defensive stats, which also increases Rammus’s damage. In the late game, you can also create pressure by attacking turrets.
RekSai.teamfight: If Rek’Sai dives onto your allied main damage dealer, counter her engage with the knockback from Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. If you can safely reach the enemy backline’s main damage dealer, engage with Rammus R Soaring Slam while rolling, knock them up, and lock them down with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. Place the aftershock from Rammus R Soaring Slam in a narrow path the enemy must cross or inside an objective pit.
RekSai.watch: When Rek’Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow takes her underground, watch for the knockup as she emerges and move toward open space, away from walls and narrow paths. Immediately after Rek’Sai damages you, Rek’Sai R Void Rush may follow, so stay close to your allies. Save Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, which requires a selected target, during her leap and use it after she lands.

Rengar.build: Build armor first against Rengar’s main damage. While Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt reduces your armor, the armor you’ve built is less effective, and armor can’t block the magic damage from Rengar W Battle Roar. Rammus P Spiked Shell converts defensive stats into attack damage, so defensive stats also help increase your damage.
Rengar.combo: After Rengar W Battle Roar is down, start rolling Rammus Q Powerball from out of vision to build speed. Just before colliding with Rengar, cast Rammus R Soaring Slam while rolling to try for a knockup. After landing, use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, then activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl and basic attack when Rengar starts attacking.
Rengar.escape: After you dodge Rengar E Bola Strike, look for an opportunity to engage with Rammus Q Powerball or Rammus R Soaring Slam. If Rengar W Battle Roar is also down and his resource bar is empty, catch him with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. Rengar has no ability to create distance on his own, so he’ll have a hard time escaping once caught.
Rengar.fight: Fight after Rengar’s resource bar is empty and Rengar W Battle Roar is down. Dodge Rengar E Bola Strike, approach with Rammus Q Powerball, then catch him with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. Activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl when Rengar actually starts attacking you.
Rengar.laning: Rammus clears camps slowly and is weak in the early farming race, so spend time on ganks and objectives once Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt are available. Avoid paths beside brush when Rengar is out of sight, and use Control Wards to get vision in brush. If there’s no opening to gank, don’t force it; retreat with Rammus Q Powerball.
Rengar.phase: Early on, Rammus clears camps slowly and deals little damage alone, so don’t rush into fights with Rengar. As Rammus builds defensive items in the mid to late game, his damage increases too, and he can pressure by taking down turrets in the late game.
Rengar.teamfight: Set your formation so your backline stays behind the frontline against Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt. When Rengar leaps in, confirm whether he uses Rengar W Battle Roar, then counter his engage with Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. If you can’t catch Rengar in the current situation, don’t force an engage; stay in front of your allied main damage dealer and protect them.
Rengar.watch: Rengar P Unseen Predator lets him leap from brush and generate resource, so avoid paths beside brush when you can’t see him. When his resource bar is full, Rengar E Bola Strike can root you and Rengar W Battle Roar can remove crowd control, so don’t start a fight then. When Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt is active, don’t roam alone while injured; stay with your allies.

Sejuani.build: Build magic resistance first to blunt Sejuani’s main damage, and prioritize tenacity too if her crowd control keeps you locked down. Building a lot of health alone also increases the damage from Sejuani P Fury of the North, so get resistance stats. Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl increases both armor and magic resistance.
Sejuani.combo: When Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down, roll in with Rammus Q Powerball, collide with her, then catch her with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt and activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl when she starts attacking. If you need a knockup to engage, cast Rammus R Soaring Slam while rolling with Rammus Q Powerball, just before reaching your target. You can’t create that knockup after Rammus Q Powerball stops on collision.
Sejuani.escape: Sejuani is open to an engage just after using Q Arctic Assault. Close the gap with Rammus R Soaring Slam, then catch her with Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. If you’re at high risk of being locked down by Sejuani’s crowd control or there’s no good opening, retreat with Rammus Q Powerball.
Sejuani.fight: Close the gap and fight just after you make Sejuani use Q Arctic Assault. If Sejuani’s Frost Armor is active, damage her first to remove her slow immunity, then use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt to prevent her from disengaging. Activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl only after Sejuani actually starts attacking you.
Sejuani.laning: Rammus clears camps slowly early, so look for ganks once Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt are available instead of focusing on the farming race. Start rolling Rammus Q Powerball from out of vision, and engage along a path that avoids minions and neutral monsters. Use Sejuani’s weak early damage and kill pressure to seek jungle control and objectives.
Sejuani.phase: Early on, both champions deal little damage alone, but Rammus can gank once Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt are available. Sejuani gets tankier if you give her time to scale, so look for early objectives and use turret pressure in the late game too.
Sejuani.teamfight: Dodge Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and Sejuani R Glacial Prison while looking for a chance to use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt on the enemy backline’s main damage dealer. If you can engage, use Rammus R Soaring Slam while rolling with Rammus Q Powerball to lock down that area. If reaching the backline is difficult, counter Sejuani’s engage with the knockback from Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt in front of your allied main damage dealer.
Sejuani.watch: Dodge Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and Sejuani R Glacial Prison by moving sideways. If Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath’s first hit lands, get out of range before its second hit. Sejuani and her melee allies can build stacks of Sejuani E Permafrost, so immediately create distance as the stacks build up.

Shaco.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Shaco W Jack In The Box, Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison, and Shaco R Hallucinate. You can build Spirit Visage or Banshee’s Veil early, and Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl also increases your magic resistance. Get health as well to avoid the low health range where Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison deals more damage.
Shaco.combo: After Shaco Q Deceive is down, start rolling Rammus Q Powerball from out of vision to build speed. If you have a chance to knock him up, cast Rammus R Soaring Slam while rolling, just before reaching Shaco, then catch him with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. When Shaco starts attacking you, activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl and basic attack.
Shaco.escape: The opening to engage comes just after you make Shaco use Shaco Q Deceive. Check paths where Shaco W Jack In The Box may have been placed, then close the gap with Rammus R Soaring Slam and chain Rammus Q Powerball into Rammus E Frenzying Taunt.
Shaco.fight: Focus your damage with your allies just after Shaco uses Shaco Q Deceive to engage and reveals himself. Once you’ve made Shaco use Shaco Q Deceive, close the gap with Rammus R Soaring Slam, then catch him with Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. Activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl only after Shaco actually starts attacking you.
Shaco.laning: Early on, maintain vision at your allied jungle entrances to watch for Shaco’s ganks and invades. Rammus should spend time on ganks and objectives once Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt are available instead of competing to farm early. When entering a path without vision, check for Shaco W Jack In The Box first.
Shaco.phase: Early on, watch for Shaco’s ganks and invades, avoid giving up kills, and secure vision and objectives. In the mid to late game, make use of Rammus’s strength as he builds defensive items, and pressure turrets in the late game too.
