Shaco.teamfight: When Shaco uses Shaco Q Deceive to engage and appears, immediately focus damage on the real Shaco with your allies and catch him with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. Watch health bar reactions so you don’t waste damage on Shaco R Hallucinate’s clone; if you kill the clone, move away from its explosion and the box’s fear. If you can’t taunt the enemy main damage dealer, counter their engage with Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt in front of your allied carry.
Shaco.watch: Watch for the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box in areas without vision, including around objectives and in brush. Clear the boxes in advance with a Control Ward or Oracle Lens. If you can’t clear them, start the objective from a position where you have room to retreat even if feared. When your health is low, Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison is dangerous, so avoid paths without vision after a fight.

Skarner.build: First decide whether you need a way to escape the suppression from Skarner R Impale; if you do, consider Quicksilver Sash. Build magic resistance first against the damage from Skarner P Threads of Vibration, Skarner W Seismic Bastion, and Skarner R Impale.
Skarner.combo: When Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact is down, roll in with Rammus Q Powerball and cast Rammus R Soaring Slam before colliding to knock up Skarner near the center. Follow with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, then activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl and basic attack when Skarner starts attacking you.
Skarner.escape: Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact is his only movement ability, so immediately after he uses it is an opening to engage. At that point, close the gap with Rammus R Soaring Slam, then catch him with Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. You can’t interrupt Skarner R Impale with Rammus’s crowd control, so don’t engage expecting to stop it.
Skarner.fight: Close the gap just after Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact is down. Avoid a long trade where you keep taking empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth / Upheaval, and activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl when you catch Skarner with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. Save its duration by activating Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl only after Skarner actually starts attacking you.
Skarner.laning: Rammus clears camps slowly and deals little damage alone early, so clear camps and look for ganks and objective opportunities instead of competing to farm. Once Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt are available, start rolling Rammus Q Powerball from out of vision to engage. If there’s no opening, retreat with Rammus Q Powerball.
Skarner.phase: Early on, Rammus clears camps slowly and deals little damage alone; ganks become viable once Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt are available. In the mid game, join objective fights once you have Rammus R Soaring Slam, and look for opportunities to keep Skarner from reaching his item spikes early. Rammus is at his strongest in the mid to late game with defensive items, and can also pressure turrets in the late game.
Skarner.teamfight: If Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact is down, engage with Rammus Q Powerball and lock down the enemy backline’s main damage dealer with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. If reaching that target is difficult, counter Skarner’s engage with the knockback from Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt in front of your allied carry. During objective fights, avoid the edges of the pit so Skarner R Impale can’t drag you inside, and use Rammus R Soaring Slam on a path the enemy must cross or inside the pit.
Skarner.watch: Even if you’re hit by Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact, stand in open space so you don’t collide with a wall. Skarner R Impale suppresses and drags you, so avoid the edge of objective pits and positions that would pull you toward Skarner’s allies. Keep your distance so you don’t keep taking empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth / Upheaval at close range.

Taliyah.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Taliyah Q Threaded Volley and Taliyah E Unraveled Earth. Don’t stack only armor; buy Spirit Visage or Banshee’s Veil earlier. Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl also increases magic resistance, so activate it after the enemy starts attacking.
Taliyah.combo: Start rolling Rammus Q Powerball out of vision to build speed, and choose a route that avoids the rock field from Taliyah E Unraveled Earth. To knock up enemies at the center with Rammus R Soaring Slam, cast it while rolling with Rammus Q Powerball, just before reaching the position above Taliyah. Once you’re on her, use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. When Taliyah starts attacking Rammus, activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl and use basic attacks.
Taliyah.escape: The window to engage is while Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall is down. If only Taliyah E Unraveled Earth is down, she can still escape with Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall, so check for her other escape options too. If the rock field from Taliyah E Unraveled Earth remains, go around it instead of using Rammus R Soaring Slam to cross it.
Taliyah.fight: Find an approach that avoids the rock field from Taliyah E Unraveled Earth. Look for an engage while Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall is down, and check whether Taliyah E Unraveled Earth is down too. Once you’re close, lock Taliyah down with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt and keep dealing damage so she can’t escape with Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall.
Taliyah.laning: Rammus is weak at clearing early camps and competing for farm, so focus on ganks and objective plays once you have Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. For ganks, start rolling Rammus Q Powerball out of vision and approach around minions. If Taliyah disappears from the jungle, watch for her to impact another lane with Taliyah P Rock Surfing and Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall, and back off early.
Taliyah.phase: Early on, Rammus is weak at clearing camps and dealing damage alone, so don’t rush ganks until you have Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. If a late-game team fight stalls, you can apply pressure by taking down turrets with Rammus R Soaring Slam and Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl.
Taliyah.teamfight: Check for the rock field from Taliyah E Unraveled Earth before engaging, then lock Taliyah down with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. Use Rammus R Soaring Slam in a narrow passage Taliyah must cross or in an objective pit to take advantage of the aftershock’s slow. If you can’t reach Taliyah, don’t force the engage; stand in front of your team’s main damage dealer and counter enemy engages with Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt.
Taliyah.watch: Taliyah Q Threaded Volley cannot change direction once cast, so dodge sideways instead of running straight toward or away from her. Don’t use Rammus R Soaring Slam to charge over the rock field while it remains.

Udyr.build: Build armor early against Udyr’s basic attacks. If the magic damage from Udyr R Wingborne Storm is a concern, build magic resistance too. Since he deals damage based on your maximum health, avoid relying on a large health stack alone. Rammus also gains attack damage when he builds defensive stats.
Udyr.combo: Start rolling Rammus Q Powerball out of vision to build speed, then use Rammus R Soaring Slam just before reaching Udyr to aim for a knockup at the center. After landing, lock him down with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. When Udyr starts attacking Rammus, activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl and use basic attacks. Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s empowered form is immune to immobilizing effects, so taunt him after it ends.
Udyr.escape: The window to engage opens right after you bait out Udyr E Blazing Stampede. If its empowered effect has ended, close the gap with Rammus R Soaring Slam and lock him down with Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. If you’ve already taken a stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede, retaliate or disengage while he can’t stun you again.
Udyr.fight: Go in while Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield is down and don’t give him time to heal. Bait out Udyr E Blazing Stampede before approaching, but if it’s empowered, save Rammus E Frenzying Taunt until the immobilizing effect ends. If there’s no opening, use Rammus Q Powerball to disengage.
Udyr.laning: Early on, Rammus is weak at clearing camps and dealing damage alone, so focus on ganks and objective plays instead of competing for farm. When Udyr is missing, track his path with vision at key routes and jungle entrances, and tell your allies not to overextend. Look for ganks once you have Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt.
Udyr.phase: Early on, Rammus is weak at clearing camps and dealing damage alone, so don’t overcommit until you have Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. In the mid to late game, your damage also increases as you build defensive items, and in the late game you can pressure turrets.
Udyr.teamfight: Don’t try to burst down Udyr first when he has defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle; target the weaker enemies behind him. Engage with Rammus Q Powerball, lock down their main damage dealer with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, and place the aftershock from Rammus R Soaring Slam on a path enemies must cross. If there’s no opening, stand in front of your team’s main damage dealer and counter Udyr’s engage with the knockback from Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt.
Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede closes the gap quickly and stuns, so be careful with your distance right after he activates it. Udyr Q Wilding Claw empowers his basic attacks and deals damage based on your maximum health, while Udyr R Wingborne Storm slows and deals magic damage based on your maximum health. Once you’ve taken one stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede, you’ll have a chance to retaliate or disengage.

Vi.combo: After Vi Q Vault Breaker is down, roll in with Rammus Q Powerball and collide with her, then use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. When Vi starts attacking, activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl and use basic attacks. To knock her up with Rammus R Soaring Slam, cast it while rolling with Rammus Q Powerball, just before you reach her. If you cast R after colliding and stopping, it won’t knock her up.
Vi.escape: Vi Q Vault Breaker is her only mobility tool, so the window to engage opens right after you bait it out or dodge it. Close the gap with Rammus R Soaring Slam, then chain Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt to prevent Vi from escaping.
Vi.fight: Close the gap right after dodging or baiting out Vi Q Vault Breaker. If Vi P Blast Shield is active, fight briefly after it breaks, then create distance before Vi W Denting Blows stacks up. Save your displacement while Vi R Cease and Desist is in progress, then respond after she lands with Rammus Q Powerball or Rammus E Frenzying Taunt.
Vi.laning: Rammus should spend time clearing camps and using the long engage range of Rammus Q Powerball for ganks and objective plays instead of competing for farm early. Try to gank once you have both Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt; if there’s no opening, use Rammus Q Powerball to disengage. If Vi dives under an allied turret, use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt to make her take turret shots.
Vi.phase: Early on, Rammus is weak at clearing camps and dealing damage alone, so play around until you have Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt instead of fighting Vi for too long. In the mid to late game, your damage also increases as you build defensive stats, and in the late game you can apply pressure by taking down turrets.
Vi.teamfight: Vi R Cease and Desist pursues its target all the way, so stay near your backline damage dealers and prepare for her engage. Once Vi lands and the knockup ends, protect your allies with Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. If you can reach the enemy backline’s main damage dealer, approach with Rammus Q Powerball, use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, and trap them there with Rammus R Soaring Slam.
Vi.watch: Vi Q Vault Breaker deals heavy damage when fully charged, so back away or sidestep when you see her charge it. Vi W Denting Blows reduces a target’s armor and increases her attack speed the more she hits them, so don’t stay in a prolonged fight. Don’t try to knock her back with Rammus Q Powerball while she’s charging in with Vi R Cease and Desist; respond after she lands and the knockup ends.
Vi.build: Build armor early because Vi deals primarily physical damage. Vi W Denting Blows reduces armor and deals damage based on maximum health, so prioritize armor and effects that reduce attack speed over stacking health alone.

Viego.build: Build armor early against the physical damage from Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King and Viego R Heartbreaker. Viego W Spectral Maw deals magic damage, which armor can’t block. If the duel drags on, build resistances first, then get Grievous Wounds to counter the healing from Viego P Sovereign’s Domination and Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King.
Viego.combo: Start rolling Rammus Q Powerball out of vision to build speed, then approach Viego. If you have a chance to knock him up, cast Rammus R Soaring Slam just before you collide and stop, then use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. When Viego starts attacking Rammus, activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl and use basic attacks.
Viego.escape: Don’t engage just because Viego W Spectral Maw is down. Look for a window before Viego R Heartbreaker comes back, close the gap with Rammus R Soaring Slam, and lock him down with Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. If there’s no opening, disengage with Rammus Q Powerball along a route that won’t collide with an enemy or minion.
Viego.fight: While Viego W Spectral Maw is charging, move sideways and interrupt it with Rammus Q Powerball or Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. After engaging, activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl when Viego starts attacking Rammus. In skirmishes you can’t win, back off without giving up a kill.
Viego.laning: Rammus is weak at clearing camps and dealing damage alone early, so focus on ganks and objective plays using the long engage range of Rammus Q Powerball instead of competing for farm. Look for ganks once you have both Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, and start rolling out of vision to build speed. Don’t push a lane toward the area where Viego E Harrowed Path’s black mist is visible.
Viego.phase: In the mid to late game, build defensive stats to increase your damage too. If a late-game team fight stalls, apply pressure by taking down turrets.
Viego.teamfight: If an ally is killed in front of Viego, knock Viego away with Rammus Q Powerball or lock him down with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt so he can’t interact with the wraith. If you can taunt the enemy main damage dealer, target them; if they’re hard to reach, stand in front of your team’s carry and counter incoming enemies. Use Rammus R Soaring Slam in a narrow passage Viego must cross or in an objective pit.
Viego.watch: Viego W Spectral Maw’s stun lasts longer the more he charges it, so sidestep when you see him charging and interrupt it with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. Viego R Heartbreaker targets champions with a low percentage of their health remaining, so back away when your health is low. If you see black mist around terrain, Viego may be camouflaged in Viego E Harrowed Path, so avoid that area.

Warwick.build: Build magic resistance early against the magic damage from Warwick P Eternal Hunger, Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast, and Warwick R Infinite Duress. His basic attacks also hurt, so build armor as well. If the duel drags on, build resistances first, then get Executioner’s Calling to apply Grievous Wounds.
Warwick.combo: Build speed in advance with Rammus Q Powerball, then use Rammus R Soaring Slam while rolling just before reaching Warwick to knock him up at the center. Follow with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. When Warwick starts attacking Rammus, activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl and use basic attacks.
Warwick.escape: Don’t engage just because Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast is down; look for a window when Warwick R Infinite Duress is also unavailable. After the fear from Warwick E Primal Howl triggers, close the gap with Rammus R Soaring Slam and lock Warwick down with Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt.
Warwick.fight: Don’t dump your damage while Warwick E Primal Howl is active; fight again after the fear triggers. After engaging, activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl when Warwick starts attacking Rammus, then use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt to keep Warwick’s attacks focused on you.
Warwick.laning: Rammus is weak at clearing camps and dealing damage alone early, so avoid forcing a duel with Warwick and clear camps while looking for gank opportunities. Once you have both Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, engage after starting to roll out of vision. If your health falls below half, your position is revealed to Warwick, so recall even if you have to give up some farm.
Warwick.phase: Early on, Rammus is weak at clearing camps and dealing damage alone, so look for gank opportunities without giving Warwick a kill. In the mid to late game, your damage also increases as you build defensive items, and in the late game you can apply pressure by taking down turrets.
Warwick.teamfight: If Warwick R Infinite Duress suppresses an ally, interrupt his channel with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt to protect them. If you can reach an enemy main damage dealer, engage with Rammus Q Powerball, use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, and trap them there with the aftershock from Rammus R Soaring Slam. If there’s no opening, stand in front of your team’s carry and counter Warwick’s engage with the knockback from Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt.
Warwick.watch: While Warwick E Primal Howl is active, he takes reduced damage and triggers fear, so back off and reengage after the fear. If Warwick R Infinite Duress hits you, you are suppressed and can act, so watch for his leap even from a distance when his movement speed is increased.

XinZhao.build: Build armor early because Xin Zhao deals primarily physical damage. Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge deals magic damage, but it’s still better to prioritize armor over stacking health. Since basic attacks and attack speed are the core of his damage, reducing his attack speed is also effective.
XinZhao.combo: Once Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is down, roll in with Rammus Q Powerball. To aim for a knockup, cast Rammus R Soaring Slam while rolling, just before you reach the enemy, then lock him down with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. When Xin Zhao starts attacking Rammus, activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl.
XinZhao.escape: If you engage right after baiting out Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge, he’ll have a hard time dashing away again. Create distance before the third hit of Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike to avoid the knockup. Once the immunity from Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends, reengage and fight back.
XinZhao.fight: The window to close the gap opens right after Xin Zhao uses Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. Lock him down with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, and activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl once he actually starts attacking Rammus. If Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, attack again after the immunity ends.
XinZhao.laning: Once you have Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, start rolling out of vision and look for ganks. If there’s no opening, disengage with Rammus Q Powerball.
XinZhao.phase: Early on, Rammus is weak at clearing camps and dealing damage alone, so don’t force a fight with Xin Zhao. In the mid to late game, your damage also increases as you build armor, and in the late game you can apply pressure by taking down turrets.
XinZhao.teamfight: If Xin Zhao uses Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge to jump on an ally, lock him down with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt to protect them. Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard can split your formation with its knockback, so don’t stand too close to your allies. If you can catch the enemy backline’s main damage dealer, engage with Rammus Q Powerball, use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, and trap them there with Rammus R Soaring Slam.
XinZhao.watch: Sidestep the later thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning. If you’ve been hit twice by empowered basic attacks from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike, move out of range with Rammus Q Powerball or Rammus R Soaring Slam before the third hit knocks you up. While Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, damage from outside his spear range won’t affect him, so wait for the immunity to end.

Zac.build: Zac Q Stretching Strikes, Zac W Unstable Matter, and Zac E Elastic Slingshot deal magic damage, so build magic resistance early. You can buy Spirit Visage or Banshee’s Veil earlier than usual. Avoid stacking only armor or relying solely on a large amount of health against Zac W Unstable Matter.
Zac.combo: While rolling with Rammus Q Powerball, use Rammus R Soaring Slam just before reaching the enemy to knock up enemies at the center of its area. After landing, lock Zac down with Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. When Zac starts attacking Rammus, activate Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl and use basic attacks. If Zac is charging Zac E Elastic Slingshot, interrupt him first with Rammus Q Powerball or Rammus E Frenzying Taunt.
Zac.escape: If you go in right after Zac uses Zac E Elastic Slingshot, he can’t escape with that mobility spell. You can also interrupt Zac E Elastic Slingshot while he’s charging with Rammus Q Powerball or Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, then fight. Check whether Zac’s resurrection passive is down before deciding to engage.
Zac.fight: The window to close the gap opens right after you bait out Zac E Elastic Slingshot. Approach with Rammus R Soaring Slam, then lock Zac down with Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt.
Zac.laning: Rammus clears camps slowly and deals little damage alone early, so focus on ganks after you have Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt instead of competing for farm. Start rolling Rammus Q Powerball out of vision to build speed, and choose an approach that avoids minions and neutral monsters. If there’s no gank opening, disengage with Rammus Q Powerball.
Zac.phase: Early on, Rammus is weak at clearing camps and dealing damage alone, so avoid forcing fights until you have Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. In the late game, you can also leave a stalled team fight and pressure turrets.
Zac.teamfight: If you see Zac charging Zac E Elastic Slingshot, interrupt him with Rammus Q Powerball or Rammus E Frenzying Taunt to stop his engage. If you can reach the enemy backline’s main damage dealer, engage with Rammus Q Powerball, use Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, and trap them there with the aftershock from Rammus R Soaring Slam. If they’re hard to reach, counter Zac’s engage from in front of your allies and step on the chunks he leaves behind to prevent him from healing.
Zac.watch: Zac E Elastic Slingshot charges before launching him forward and knocking you up, so if you see him charging behind a wall, interrupt him with Rammus Q Powerball or Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. Zac W Unstable Matter deals damage based on your maximum health, so create distance after you stop his engage. Step on the chunks of his body to prevent him from healing.
